page.content:
Ming hundred-chapter novel attributed to Wu Cheng'en.

How Journey to the West (novel) connects

  • Topic: Journey to the West — The Ming novel is the canonical telling of the Journey to the West cycle.
  • Creator: Wu Cheng'en — Wu Cheng'en is the traditional author of the hundred-chapter novel.
  • Character: Xuanzang — Xuanzang's pilgrimage is the historical seed of the novel.

What is Journey to the West (novel)?

The novel Xiyouji, printed in the 1590s and traditionally ascribed to Wu Cheng'en, is the canonical telling: Wukong's rebellion, the disciples' recruitment, and the westward episodes that later opera and film keep retelling.

Key threads lead to Journey to the West, Wu Cheng'en and Xuanzang.
